readings.title: Leprosy in a House
readings.subtitle: Inspection and Cleansing
readings.text: [Leviticus 14:33] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [34] <dq>“When you come into the land of Kena’an, which <dn>I</dn> give you for a possession, and <dn>I</dn> put the plague of leprosy in a house in the land of your possession,</dq> [35] <dq>and he who owns the house comes and reports to the priest, saying, ‘It seems to me like a plague in the house,’</dq> [36] <dq>then the priest shall command that they empty <dn>את</dn> the house, before the priest goes in to look at <dn>את</dn> the plague, so that all that is in the house is not made unclean. And after that the priest goes in to look at <dn>את</dn> the house.</dq> [37] <dq>“And he shall look at <dn>את</dn> the plague, and see, if the plague is on the walls of the house with greenish or reddish depressions, and appears deeper than the wall,</dq> [38] <dq>then the priest shall go out of the house, to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.</dq> [39] <dq>“And the priest shall come again on the seventh day and look. And see, if the plague has spread on the walls of the house,</dq> [40] <dq>then the priest shall command that they remove <dn>את</dn> the stones with the plague in them, and they shall throw <dn>את</dn> them outside the city into an unclean place,</dq> [41] <dq>and he shall cause <dn>את</dn> the house to be scraped inside, all around, and the dust that they scrape off they shall pour out in an unclean place outside the city,</dq> [42] <dq>and they shall take other stones and put them in the place of those stones, and he shall take other dust and plaster <dn>את</dn> the house.</dq> [43] <dq>“And if the plague comes back and breaks out in the house, after he has removed <dn>את</dn> the stones and after he has scraped <dn>את</dn> the house, and after it is plastered,</dq> [44] <dq>then the priest shall come and look. And see, if the plague has spread in the house, it is an active leprosy in the house. It is unclean.</dq> [45] <dq>“And he shall break down <dn>את</dn> the house, <dn>את</dn> its stones, and <dn>את</dn> its timber, and <dn>את</dn> all the plaster of the house, and he shall take them outside the city to an unclean place.</dq> [46] <dq>“And he who goes into the house, all the days he has shut it up, becomes unclean until evening.</dq> [47] <dq>“And he who sleeps in the house has to wash his garments. And he who eats in the house has to wash his garments.</dq> [48] <dq>“And if the priest comes in and looks, and sees that the plague has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.</dq> [49] <dq>“And he shall take, to cleanse <dn>את</dn> the house, <dn>את</dn> two birds and <dn>את</dn> cedar wood and <dn>את</dn> scarlet and <dn>את</dn> hyssop.</dq> [50] <dq>“And he shall slaughter <dn>את</dn> one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water,</dq> [51] <dq>and he shall take <dn>את</dn> the cedar wood and <dn>את</dn> the hyssop and <dn>את</dn> the scarlet and <dn>את</dn> the living bird, and dip <dn>את</dn> them in the blood of the slain bird and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.</dq> [52] <dq>“And he shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> the house with the blood of the bird and the running water and the living bird and the cedar wood and the hyssop and the scarlet.</dq> [53] <dq>“And he shall let <dn>את</dn> the living bird loose outside the city in the open field, and make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.</dq> [54] <dq>“This is the Torah for any leprous sore and scale,</dq> [55] <dq>and for the leprosy of a garment and of a house,</dq> [56] <dq>and for a swelling and for a scab and for a bright spot,</dq> [57] <dq>to teach when it is unclean and when it is clean. This is the Torah of leprosy.”</dq>

readings.title: Uncleanness of Issues
readings.subtitle: Regulations for Men and Women
readings.text: [Leviticus 15:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’el, and say to them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his flesh, his discharge is unclean.</dq> [3] <dq>‘And this is his uncleanness in regard to his discharge: whether his flesh runs with his discharge, or his flesh is stopped up by his discharge, it is his uncleanness.</dq> [4] <dq>‘Any bed the one with the discharge lies on is unclean, and any object he sits on is unclean.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And anyone who touches his bed has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [6] <dq>‘And he who sits on the object on which the one with the discharge sat has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [7] <dq>‘And he who touches the flesh of the one with the discharge has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And if the one with the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And any saddle the one with the discharge rides on is unclean.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And whoever touches anything that was under him is unclean until evening. And he who bears <dn>את</dn> them has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [11] <dq>‘And whomever the one with the discharge touches, and has not rinsed <dn>את</dn> his hands in water, he shall wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [12] <dq>‘And the earthen vessel that the one with the discharge touches is broken, and every wooden vessel is rinsed in water.</dq> [13] <dq>‘And when the one with the discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his garments and bathe <dn>את</dn> his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And on the eighth day he takes for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and shall come before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.</dq> [15] <dq>‘And the priest shall prepare them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> because of his discharge.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And when a man has an emission of semen, then he shall wash <dn>את</dn> all his flesh in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [17] <dq>‘And any garment and any leather on which there is semen, it shall be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [18] <dq>‘And when a woman lies with a man, and there is an emission of semen, they both shall wash in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [19] <dq>‘And when a woman has a discharge, and the discharge from her flesh is blood, she is in her separation for seven days. And whoever touches her is unclean until evening.</dq> [20] <dq>‘And whatever she lies on during her separation is unclean, and whatever she sits on is unclean.</dq> [21] <dq>‘And whoever touches her bed has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [22] <dq>‘And whoever touches any object she sat on has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [23] <dq>‘And if it is on her bed or on the object she sits on, when he touches it, he is unclean until evening.</dq> [24] <dq>‘And if a man lies with <dn>את</dn> her at all, and her separation is on him, he is unclean seven days, and any bed he lies on is unclean.</dq> [25] <dq>‘And when a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her separation, or when she has a discharge beyond her separation, all the days of her unclean discharge shall be as the days of her separation. She is unclean.</dq> [26] <dq>‘Any bed she lies on all the days of her discharge is to her as the bed of her separation, and whatever she sits on is unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.</dq> [27] <dq>‘And whoever touches them is unclean, and has to wash his garments and wash himself in water, and be unclean until evening.</dq> [28] <dq>‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she is clean.</dq> [29] <dq>‘And on the eighth day she takes for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and brings them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.</dq> [30] <dq>‘And the priest shall prepare the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for the discharge of her uncleanness.</dq> [31] <dq>‘Thus you shall separate <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’el from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness when they defile <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Dwelling Place which is in their midst.</dq> [32] <dq>‘This is the Torah for one who has a discharge, and for him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby,</dq> [33] <dq>‘and for her who is sick in her separation, and for one who has a discharge, of the male or female, and for a man who lies with an unclean woman.’”</dq>

readings.section: The Day of The Protective Shelters
readings.title: Yom HaKippurim
readings.subtitle: The Annual Cleansing of the Sanctuary
readings.text: [Leviticus 16:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh after the death of the two sons of Aharon, as they drew near before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and died. [2] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Speak to Aharon your brother not to come in at all times into the Set-apart Place inside the veil, before the lid of atonement which is on the ark, lest he die, because <dn>I</dn> appear in the cloud above the lid of atonement.</dq> [3] <dq>“With this Aharon should come into the Set-apart Place: with the blood of a young bull as a sin offering, and of a ram as a burnt offering.</dq> [4] <dq>“He should put on the set-apart linen long shirt, with linen trousers on his flesh, and gird himself with a linen girdle, and be dressed with the linen turban – they are set-apart garments. And he shall bathe <dn>את</dn> his flesh in water, and put them on.</dq> [5] <dq>“And from the congregation of the children of Yisra’el he takes two male goats as a sin offering, and one ram as a burnt offering.</dq> [6] <dq>“And Aharon shall bring <dn>את</dn> the bull as a sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.</dq> [7] <dq>“And he shall take <dn>את</dn> the two goats and present them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at the door of the Tent of Meeting.</dq> [8] <dq>“And Aharon shall cast lots for the two goats, one lot for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and the other lot for Azazel.</dq> [9] <dq>“And Aharon shall bring <dn>את</dn> the goat on which the lot for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> fell, and prepare it as a sin offering.</dq> [10] <dq>“But the goat on which the lot for Azazel fell is presented alive before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to make atonement upon it, to send it into the wilderness to Azazel.</dq> [11] <dq>“And Aharon shall bring <dn>את</dn> the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall slaughter <dn>את</dn> the bull as the sin offering which is for himself.</dq> [12] <dq>“And he shall take a fire holder filled with burning coals of fire from the altar before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, with his hands full of sweet incense beaten fine, and shall bring it inside the veil.</dq> [13] <dq>“And he shall put <dn>את</dn> the incense on the fire before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the cloud of incense shall cover the lid of atonement which is on the Witness, lest he die.</dq> [14] <dq>“And he shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the lid of atonement on the east side, and before the lid of atonement he sprinkles some of the blood with his finger seven times.</dq> [15] <dq>“And he shall slaughter <dn>את</dn> the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, and bring <dn>את</dn> its blood inside the veil, and shall do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the lid of atonement and before the lid of atonement.</dq> [16] <dq>“And he shall make atonement for the Set-apart Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yisra’el, and because of their transgressions in all their sins. And so he does for the Tent of Meeting which is dwelling with them in the midst of their uncleanness.</dq> [17] <dq>“And no man should be in the Tent of Meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the Set-apart Place, until he comes out. And he shall make atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Yisra’el.</dq> [18] <dq>“And he shall go out to the altar that is before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and make atonement for it. And he shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar all around.</dq> [19] <dq>“And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and set it apart from the uncleanness of the children of Yisra’el.</dq> [20] <dq>“And when he has finished atoning for <dn>את</dn> the Set-apart Place, and <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Meeting, and <dn>את</dn> the altar, he shall bring <dn>את</dn> the live goat.</dq> [21] <dq>“Then Aharon shall lay <dn>את</dn> both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it <dn>את</dn> all the crookednesses of the children of Yisra’el, and <dn>את</dn> all their transgressions in all their sins, and shall put <dn>את</dn> them on the head of the goat, and shall send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a fit man.</dq> [22] <dq>“And the goat shall bear on itself <dn>את</dn> all their crookednesses to a land cut off. Thus he shall send <dn>את</dn> the goat away into the wilderness.</dq> [23] <dq>“And Aharon shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off <dn>את</dn> the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Set-apart Place, and shall leave them there.</dq> [24] <dq>“And he shall bathe <dn>את</dn> his flesh in water in a set-apart place, and put on <dn>את</dn> his garments, and shall come out and prepare <dn>את</dn> his burnt offering and <dn>את</dn> the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people,</dq> [25] <dq>“and burn <dn>את</dn> the fat of the sin offering on the altar.</dq> [26] <dq>“And he who sent away the goat to Azazel washes his garments, and shall bathe <dn>את</dn> his flesh in water, and afterwards he comes into the camp.</dq> [27] <dq>“And the bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Set-apart Place, is brought outside the camp. And they shall burn their skins, and <dn>את</dn> their flesh, and <dn>את</dn> their dung with fire.</dq> [28] <dq>“And he who burns them washes his garments, and shall bathe <dn>את</dn> his flesh in water, and afterwards he comes into the camp.</dq> [29] <dq>“And this shall be for you a law forever: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you afflict <dn>את</dn> your beings, and do no work, the native or the stranger who sojourns among you.</dq> [30] <dq>“For on this day atonement is made for you, to cleanse you, to be clean from all your sins before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [31] <dq>“It is a Sabbath of rest for you, and you shall afflict <dn>את</dn> your beings – a law forever.</dq> [32] <dq>“And the priest, who is anointed and ordained to serve as priest in his father’s place, shall make atonement, and put on <dn>את</dn> the linen garments, <dn>את</dn> the set-apart garments,</dq> [33] <dq>“and he shall make atonement for <dn>את</dn> the Most Set-apart Place, and make atonement for <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Meeting and for <dn>את</dn> the altar, and make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.</dq> [34] <dq>“And this shall be for you a law forever, to make atonement for the children of Yisra’el, for all their sins, once a year.”</dq> And he did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh.
